title: US Marine Corps Expands 'Project Dynamis' With Predictive AI Logistics Platform | Rune Technologies News
summary: The US Marine Corps integrated Rune Technologies' TyrOS predictive logistics AI platform into Project Dynamis to enhance supply chain visibility and anticipate shortfalls during distributed military operations.
body_markdown:
The Defense Post covered Rune Technologies by Samantha Alexa in a piece titled “US Marine Corps Expands 'Project Dynamis' With Predictive AI Logistics Platform.” The US Marine Corps integrated Rune Technologies' TyrOS predictive logistics AI platform into Project Dynamis to enhance supply chain visibility and anticipate shortfalls during distributed military operations.


Read the full article[here](https://thedefensepost.com/2026/05/27/tyros-project-dynamis-ai-logistics/) .
